name: AtomStack A24 Pro
tagline: Compact Atomstack with diode + fiber marking in one desktop unit
tldr: AtomStack A24 Pro packs a diode engraver plus fiber marking into a smaller footprint than separate machines. Niche for jewelry-scale metal marking plus wood : not a full workshop fiber or high-power diode.
mainObjective: Dual-source Atomstack for metal marking and organic engraving

specs.workArea: 110 × 110 mm marking / ~400 mm diode area (verify SKU)

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cutExample.description: Simple square cut-out from 3 mm basswood

pros: Everyday engrave and light cut mix : typical 6 mm basswood in several passes
Software listed on the profile : test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
cons: Clear cast acrylic and thick production cutting still favor CO₂, not diode power alone
Confirm optical wattage on the listing before you buy
beginnerNotes: This profile covers AtomStack A24 Pro. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Desk hybrid for mixed metal marking and small organic engraves.

moduleSystem.headline: Diode engrave + fiber mark
moduleSystem.description: A24 Pro combines diode cutting/engraving with a fiber source for metal marking in one package.

editorialDepth.advantages: AtomStack A24 Pro 20W is the versatile hobby / side-business SKU : clean engraving and light wood or leather cuts with comparable benchmarks on Maker Atlas.
editorialDepth.limitations: Open-frame : glasses and exhaust required. Not a CO₂ replacement for clear acrylic or heavy thick-stock production.
